description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Frog creature token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Frog, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Thopter Squadron
uses.cardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it
